_meta.artifact: F-2 labelled set — (profile -> acceptable O*NET occupations)
_meta.labelled_by: agent (F-2), reviewed by Sebastian for the rows flagged confidence=low
_meta.not_a_julie_dependency: BUILD_PLAN F-2 warning 2. Every judgement here is 'would a careful person suggest this occupation to this person', which needs no I/O psychologist. Nothing in this file feeds the anchors/rater/priors work in workstream E, and nothing here should ever be sent to Julie.
_meta.code_provenance: Every onet_code below was checked against onet_occupations.json, a snapshot of the live O*NET v2 occupation universe taken 2026-09-16 in 24 API calls. tests/test_path_eval.py fails if any code here is absent from it, so the set cannot rot into hallucinated SOC codes.

grades.primary: gain 2. A career adviser who knew this person would lead with this. Being absent from the top 10 is a real miss.
grades.acceptable: gain 1. A defensible suggestion — not wrong, would not delight. Presence is credited; absence is not penalised.
grades.harmful: gain 0, AND counted separately in harmful_rate@10. Suggestions that are infeasible (credential the user does not hold), a demotion, or a known surface-form false positive. These are the failures that cost user trust, and they are the ones a precision number alone hides.
grades.anchor: EXCLUDED from every metric. The user's own resolved occupation. path_scoring._deduplicate() removes it from the candidate pool by construction (exclude_code), and 'you should be what you already are' has no product value — so it is neither credited nor penalised.

_meta.sparsity_warning: These labels cover 10-16 of ~1,016 occupations per profile. An unlabelled result is UNJUDGED, not wrong. precision@10 against this set is therefore a LOWER BOUND on true precision, and label_coverage@10 in the report is what tells you how much of the gap is ignorance rather than error. Do not tune a scorer on precision@10 alone.

confidence.high: The label would survive a second opinion.
confidence.low: FLAGGED FOR SEBASTIAN. Defensible but arguable — usually because the move depends on a credential, a portfolio, or an appetite for retraining that the profile does not state.

p19_degenerate_no_title_no_skills.why: This profile carries ZERO occupational signal — no title, no skills, no assessment. Any specific occupation labelled here would be invented, which is precisely the 'opinion wearing a number's clothing' this chunk exists to stop. Labelling it would also make the metric reward guessing.
p19_degenerate_no_title_no_skills.what_is_measured_instead: Whether the scorer returns anything at all, and what the route does with it. Today score_paths() legitimately returns [] and solverah/services/intelligence_service.py:293 turns that into a generic HTTP 500 — the live ACC-4 / S22 failure. The harness reports this profile under `degenerate`, never folded into the mean.
p19_degenerate_no_title_no_skills.what_would_count_as_fixed: BUILD_PLAN F-8 makes an unresolvable/absent title fall back to the F-7 fresh_start seed. When that lands, this profile should return a non-empty, feasibility-filtered set and the route should return 200 — and THAT is the assertion, not any particular occupation.
